subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Talk about the advantages and disadvantages of mobile phones
Understand new words and a radio phone-in
Know the full forms of common abbreviations

tf.s: 'Noise pollution' means loud and unpleasant sound.
tf.why: Yes! One caller says people are always shouting into their phones.

tf.s: 'Privacy' means the state of being alone.
tf.why: Correct! Privacy is being alone or private.

tf.s: 'Can't stand' means to dislike something strongly.
tf.why: Right! 'I can't stand noise' means I really dislike it.
Yes, an SMS is a text message.

tf.s: The caller who has never had a phone says he likes mobile phones.
tf.why: He does not like them; he likes his privacy and his peace and quiet.

tf.s: The first caller carries her phone so that the school and her husband's office can contact her.
tf.why: Yes, they can contact her at any time.

tf.s: Mobile phones have advantages only and no disadvantages.
tf.why: Phones have disadvantages too, such as cost and noise pollution.

boxes.why: 'Marvellous' is a strong word for wonderful.
Abbreviations often use the first letter of each word.

boxes.q: Which is a disadvantage of mobile phones?
boxes.why: Loss of privacy is a disadvantage.

boxes.q: Which is an advantage of mobile phones?
boxes.why: You can ring for help in an emergency.
'Uni' is an informal short form of 'university'.

boxes.q: Which object: 'I charge up the battery and plug in my earphones'?
boxes.why: Earphones are used with an MP3 player.

o: a radio show where listeners call in
boxes.why: Callers phone the radio show to give their opinions.
If you get rid of something, you remove it.
'In my opinion' introduces what you think.

o: a sudden dangerous situation that needs action
mcq.why: In an emergency you may need to ring for help.

mcq.q: Why does one caller say mobiles are noise pollution?
o: People are always shouting into them
mcq.why: Loud talking on phones makes unpleasant noise.
IT is short for information technology.

o: talk too much, often about secrets
mcq.why: People who blab talk too much.

mcq.q: How was the abbreviation 'MOE' for 'Ministry of Education' formed?
o: from the first letter of each word
from the last letter of each word
from the middle of each word
mcq.why: Many abbreviations use first letters, like USA.

mcq.q: Choose the sentence that uses abbreviations correctly.
o: The IT dept sent me an SMS.
The IT department sent me an short message servise.
The I.T dpt sent me a S.
The it Dept sended an sms.
mcq.why: IT, dept and SMS are short forms from the lesson.

o: The constant noise made me want to get rid of my old phone.
I constant my phone every day.
She is very constant to buy a phone.
mcq.why: 'Constant' is an adjective meaning 'all the time'.

mcq.q: Why does one speaker feel safe with her phone?
o: She can ring someone if she misses the bus or cannot find a taxi
mcq.why: Being able to call for help makes her feel safe.

mcq.q: A caller says, 'I like my privacy and my peace and quiet.' What can we say about him?
o: He does not like mobile phones
He works in a phone shop
mcq.why: He has never owned a phone because he likes quiet.

mcq.q: The first caller says she cannot say she likes her phone, but it is useful. What does this show?
o: She uses it because it is useful, not because she likes it
She has never had a phone
mcq.why: She keeps it so the school and her husband's office can reach her.
